scripts.dev: pnpm --parallel --filter @ludo-nexus/api run dev & pnpm --parallel --filter @ludo-nexus/web run dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ludo-nexus/api run build && pnpm --filter @ludo-nexus/web run build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @ludo-nexus/api run lint && pnpm --filter @ludo-nexus/web run lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @ludo-nexus/api run typecheck && pnpm --filter @ludo-nexus/web run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @ludo-nexus/game-engine run test && pnpm --filter @ludo-nexus/api run test && pnpm --filter @ludo-nexus/web run test && pnpm --filter @ludo-nexus/validation run test && pnpm --filter @ludo-nexus/ui run test && pnpm --filter @ludo-nexus/shared-types run test && pnpm --filter @ludo-nexus/api-client run test
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules .turbo apps/*/node_modules apps/*/.next apps/*/dist packages/*/node_modules packages/*/dist packages/*/coverage
